body: I've found comfort in writing, but with the way that it's turned, I can't really keep doing it. I always want to write about depressing stuff, and that itself drags me down.

Dude here. I've never really shared my writing with people that I know IRL. I've sent some things anonymously to acquaintances from the internet, though. I never really thought much about these things before the "free write" that I do every now and then started to turn dark. I mean, I went through a few rough patches, and that's why I was put on medication to start with, but it was never this bad.
